description: Serverside fabric version of Minecraft Bingo.

mods.name: Did Someone Say Bingo?
mods.description: A server side version of bingo made for fabric.

releases.notes:
### Changes:
- Changed format of the bingo card to have less wasted space and larger team identifiers on the card.
- Added `/bingo settings items set <item pool>` command that clears all selected item pools and sets the current item pool to be only the specified one. Swapped the bingo book to use `set` instead of `add` since you can get weird results if you don't understand how `add`, `clear`, and `remove` work.

### Bug Fixes:
- Fixed issue where players could get stuck in adventure mode when joining late, specifically during the 30 second countdown window before it drops players at the beginning.
- Updated assets in an attempt to make stained glass assets, snow, and quartz be destinguishable on the bingo card without needing to use /clarify to tell the difference between them.
